name: switchboard
description: Switchboard v2 — caveman-inspired productivity plugin for FanDuel engineers. Compresses prompts, enforces output brevity (lite/full/ultra), tracks token + USD savings, nudges to cheaper models, and shrinks MCP tool descriptions. Works with Claude Code today; Cursor and ChatGPT adapters reuse the same local daemon.

switchboard-shrink.description: Shrinks MCP tool descriptions via Switchboard daemon (30-50% reduction)
